imageGeneration.prompt: Educational geography classroom visual, rendered as a documentary landform photograph, aerial terrain view, field observation scene, or clean geographic illustration only when the slide subject benefits from a concrete visual. Use a white paper and pale ice-blue base with deep navy, teal, slate-blue, coral-red and lemon-yellow accents, clear atlas-like composition and a text-safe area. Preserve recognizable terrain structure and natural daylight; a full-bleed cover background is allowed when it improves the opening. Do not render readable labels, map text, equations, logos, UI, watermarks, glossy 3D, neon colors, generic corporate stock imagery, or cluttered collage.
